freeze_basis: The first Git commit containing this file is the immutable protocol freeze. No Sprint 1 strategy result may be inspected before that commit.
purpose: Cheap falsification of three economically distinct crypto-perpetual strategy families under Discovery v2. This protocol does not alter any existing frozen candidate and cannot authorize live trading.

data.universe_warning: Fixed present liquid universe; survivorship bias is explicitly unresolved at D0.
data.missing_data_policy: inner-align required symbols for each family; no forward fill of price or funding
data.funding_policy: use historical funding observations with their actual settlement timestamps; if unavailable for a required symbol/interval, fail closed rather than synthesize

execution.signal_information: completed bars or completed funding settlements only
execution.execution_time: next eligible bar open or next eligible event after signal formation

dispersion_conditioned_xs_momentum.mechanism: Cross-sectional momentum may be weaker following unusually high cross-sectional dispersion; condition the same causal momentum concept on a low-dispersion state rather than changing the frozen XS candidate.

signal.dispersion_measure: cross-sectional standard deviation of same-day close-to-close returns
signal.dispersion_threshold: rolling median of PRIOR dispersion observations only
signal.trade_state: trade only when completed-day dispersion is <= prior rolling median

dispersion_conditioned_xs_momentum.relationship_to_existing_candidate: NEW family only. The frozen mexc_xs_mom30_7_dn_v1 rule, clock and positions must not be modified or filtered.

funding_extreme_reversal.mechanism: Extreme perpetual funding can proxy crowded directional demand. Trade against the crowded side while receiving, or reducing payment of, the contemporaneous funding transfer when direction permits.

signal.direction: z>=+2 short; z<=-2 long; otherwise flat
signal.holding_rule: hold for one funding interval, then recompute from information available at the completed settlement
signal.portfolio: equal weight among active symbols, gross exposure capped at 1.0
signal.funding_accounting: actual historical funding cash flow only

btc_residual_shock_reversal.mechanism: After controlling each altcoin for its recent BTC beta, unusually large idiosyncratic daily shocks may partially reverse over the following day.

signal.beta_fit: OLS with intercept using PRIOR completed daily returns only
signal.shock: completed-day alt return minus beta-model prediction from same completed-day BTC return
signal.direction: long bottom residual-shock quartile, short top residual-shock quartile
signal.btc_role: factor only; BTC is not ranked as an alt

cheap_falsification.trial_accounting: all four variants per family are retained; controls are reported separately and never discarded
family_survival_requires: more than half of preregistered variants have positive mean net return at baseline costs
at least one contiguous parameter neighborhood remains positive at 1.5x baseline friction
the causal reversed/null control is materially weaker than the corresponding rule
no unexplained timestamp, funding chronology, or execution-validity failure
for cross-sectional families, leave-one-symbol-out mean net return is positive for any variant considered for replication
selection-bias diagnostics are reported whenever sample size permits
cheap_falsification.selection_rule_if_multiple_variants_surv: select the median parameter among the contiguous surviving parameter neighborhood; never select the isolated highest-PnL variant
cheap_falsification.if_family_fails: archive as FALSIFIED under this family version; do not expand or retune this frozen grid as a rescue
cheap_falsification.if_family_survives: create a new separately frozen candidate specification before independent-engine replication; prospective D4 clock begins only after that later freeze

required_outputs: one-event delay stress for any surviving family
